# Headless test for KsplatReader + the loadScene() dispatch.
#
# Reads REAL files: fixtures/ holds GaussianSplats3D's own output (one per
# compression level) for the synthetic scene in ../common, regenerated by
# ../common/generate_fixtures.mjs. The test checks each decodes back to that
# scene within its level's quantization, renders it against the source, and
# rejects byte-level corruptions of it.
add_executable(sabercat_ksplat_reader_test main.cpp)
add_dependencies(sabercat_ksplat_reader_test sabercat_shaders)
target_link_libraries(sabercat_ksplat_reader_test PRIVATE sabercat)

target_compile_definitions(sabercat_ksplat_reader_test PRIVATE
    SABERCAT_KSPLAT_FIXTURE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures"
    SHADER_DIR="${SABERCAT_SHADER_DIR}")
